actions.clearAPathPlanEachMove: Clear a path. Plan each move.

instructions.dragAPieceOrSelectItAndTapA: Drag a piece or select it and tap a highlighted destination. Positions refer to its top-left corner. A placement counts as one move; its collision-free path can turn.
instructions.dragAPieceToAHighlightedDestinationOrSel: Drag a piece to a highlighted destination, or select it and tap a highlighted cell. With a keyboard, focus a piece and press Enter, then focus a destination and press Enter. Reach the target in two moves. In harder tasks, bolted gray obstacles cannot move.
instructions.identifyTheBallSBlackTargetAndDecideWhic: Identify the ball's black target and decide which blocks must move. A target can start underneath a block.
instructions.inThisExampleMovingTheTallGreenBlockAway: In this example, moving the tall green block away opens a path for the ball. The purple block can stay where it is. Plan the destination of every piece before moving.
instructions.keepPracticingOrContinueToTheTestTheGree: Keep practicing, or continue to the test. The green block can move to row 3, column 3, freeing a path for the ball.
instructions.laterRoundsProgressFromIntroductoryToInt: Later rounds progress from introductory to intermediate (round 3), hard (round 5), and expert (round 8). Hard mode starts with complex layouts and progresses to expert; easy mode stays introductory.
instructions.moveTheRedBallToTheBlackTargetColored: Move the red ball to the black target. Colored blocks move in any direction but cannot rotate. Bolted gray obstacles stay fixed. A placement of one piece counts as one move, even if its path turns.
instructions.moveTheRedBallToTheTargetWhileMaking: Move the red ball to the target while making space around blocks. Demo moves do not affect your results.
instructions.piecesCannotOverlapRotateOrLeaveTheGridB: Pieces cannot overlap, rotate, or leave the grid. Bolted gray obstacles remain fixed. Numbered colored blocks can move in all four directions.
instructions.reachTheTargetThenChooseNextPuzzleSkipIf: Reach the target, then choose Next puzzle. Skip if stuck. Solve as many puzzles as possible in the six-minute default session. Only submitted or skipped puzzles are saved.
instructions.rearrangeColoredBlocksAndMoveTheRedBallT: Rearrange colored blocks and move the red ball to the black target in as few moves as possible. Practice inspired by motionChallenge.
instructions.resultsRecordSolveRateTimeAndMovesWithA: Results record solve rate, time, and moves, with a shortest-solution popup for each layout. Later rounds add tighter spaces and longer dependencies: intermediate after two puzzles, hard after four, and expert after seven. Expert puzzles need 9–11 optimal moves.
instructions.theBlackRingMarksTheTargetIncludingWhenA: The black ring marks the target, including when a block covers it. Numbered colored blocks can move; bolted gray obstacles cannot. This is a shortest solution under the practice move rules.
instructions.theRedBallMustReachTheBlackCircleThink: The red ball must reach the black circle. Think about which blocks stop it, and where those blocks can fit. Colored blocks move freely without rotating.
instructions.workBackwardsFromTheTargetAndOpenSpaceFo: Work backwards from the target and open space for the ball. Each step places one piece along a clear path; highlighted paths can turn.

results.thisSavedLayoutExceedsTheSolutionSearchL: This saved layout exceeds the solution search limit.
